description: Source-grounded career strategy and application production for academic faculty, research, postdoctoral and suitable professional consulting roles. Finds and verifies openings; checks eligibility; maps official portal fields; drafts tailored job application materials; audits truthful credentials; tracks submissions; and prepares interviews and follow-ups. Distinct from CV and research-paper production.
